description: Inputs from tfvars files: var-files below a root are evaluated with it, one environment each; inputs Diffseal cannot attribute are reviewed by name.

cases.name: a var-file in a directory below its root is evaluated with that root, one environment per file (source case: terraform-aws-eks-blueprints, spokes/workspaces/<env>.tfvars passed by the root's deploy script)

reasonsContain: evaluated only in part: spokes/workspaces/prod.tfvars (sets queue_name) with spokes

cases.name: a configuration change in a root with var-files is evaluated once per environment, with known values
a new var-file is a new environment: its resources are created
a tfvars file no root loads is reviewed, naming the file and the variables it changes (source case: govuk-infrastructure 94e4f1f15, terraform/variables/<env>/<root>.tfvars)
a changed terragrunt.hcl is reviewed and says Terragrunt inputs are not read
backend settings passed with -backend-config are not environments

a tfvars file in a Terragrunt directory is not a var-file of that directory: Terragrunt passes it, and Diffseal does not read Terragrunt (source case: notification-terraform 4ee07817e, env/production_config.tfvars)
a var-file below a root that changes a variable the root does not declare is reviewed, naming the variable

reasonsContain: r/envs/prod.tfvars sets image_tag, which r does not declare

cases.name: review: adding the first var-file to a root compares it with the root as it was, so a replacement in the same commit still blocks
review: a var-file renamed in the same commit as a deletion is the same environment, so the deletion still blocks
review: a var-file that no longer parses is reviewed, not treated as evaluated
review: environments with the same file name in different directories keep distinct labels
review: a deleted var-file of a root that still exists does not say the root directory is deleted

reasonsContain: Var-file r/envs/prod.tfvars of root r is deleted

cases.name: review 2: a new var-file that sets a variable its root does not declare is reviewed

reasonsContain: r/env/prod.tfvars sets image_tag, which r does not declare

cases.name: review 3: a var-file below one root that another root also declares stays reviewed, because that other root may load it
review 3: a shared var-file layered with per-environment files stays reviewed
review 4: deleting a root's last var-file is reviewed, even when it only repeated the defaults

reasonsContain: Var-file r/envs/prod.tfvars of root r is deleted
